references.text: After a leader's death, the Israelites scattered and each went their own way, a pattern repeated throughout the Book of Judges
Joshua's death also led the people to go each to their inheritance, a similar situation where a leader's death marks the end of an era
The people went each to their inheritance, the same pattern of scattering after a significant event
After a battle against Absalom, the Israelites returned to their homes, a similar response following the conclusion of a conflict
The phrase 'each to his own home' is used when the Israelites leave an assembly, the same wording found in Judges 9:55
